specification.dwg: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 20.4.92, page 221: SCALE stores paper units and drawing units as BD fields; drawing units are represented with the specified ratio convention.
specification.apiDomain: Autodesk AcDbAnnotationScale setters require paper units and drawing units to be positive and nonzero. The model additionally requires finite values for safe numeric transport.

implementation.dwgRead: DRW_Scale::parseDwg rejects zero, negative, and non-finite paper/drawing units and resets the object on failure.
implementation.dwgWrite: DRW_Scale::encodeDwg rejects zero, negative, and non-finite paper/drawing units before emitting body or string-stream bits.
implementation.scope: Enforces the annotation-scale API unit invariant across the DWG read/write boundary. DXF read/write guards are covered by the separate SCALE receipts. This does not qualify annotation rendering, version-specific native acceptance, or consumer behavior.

coverage: DWG writer checks zero, negative, NaN, and positive-infinity paper and drawing values before output for AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032.
Positive finite writer controls pass at each of the six DWG writer revisions.
Generated AC1014 parser vectors reject zero, negative, NaN, and positive-infinity values for both paper and drawing units and confirm failed records publish no partial state.

sources: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.92, p. 221 (local authoritative copy: ~/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files (1).pdf)
